name: @orbb/adherence
description: Adherence enforcement abstraction for ORBB (M6-B B10, Lane C): pure per-task adherence evaluation (on-track | missed | recovered) over the real scheduler task/window types with a full audit trail and deterministic replay; an explicit, versioned, non-punitive AdherencePolicy model that fail-closes to NO-ENFORCEMENT when absent or malformed; an injected consent/access-grant-shaped authorization gate that must pass at decision time (configured-but-unauthorized is a typed refusal with an audit record, never a silent pass); and the RestrictionDecision token — the only value OS capability adapters accept as authorization to act. Observe-only by default; restrictions are bounded and exist only under explicit, authorized, configured policy. Zero external runtime dependencies.
